status.en: 27 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 27 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Turkish troops remain in Syria and Iraq, saying they will stay until border security is guaranteed, while armed groups have used explosive-laden drones to strike Syrian security posts in Suwayda. Israel is now supporting Druze forces against President al-Sharaa, a shift from earlier reports of Druze warming to Israel. Iranian Kurdish separatists have been deported to Iraq, and Qatar’s intelligence chief says the country overhauled its entire defence system in six hours. DNA testing has identified seven family members killed in Syria, offering hope to the missing. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Tyrkiske tropper blir i Syria og Irak, og sier de vil bli til grense­ sikkerheten er garantert, mens væpnede grupper har brukt droner lastet med sprengstoff til å angripe syriske sikkerhetsposter i Suwayda. Israel støtter nå drusiske styrker mot president al-Sharaa, en endring fra tidligere rapporter om at drusene var blitt varmere mot Israel. Iranske kurdiske separatister er blitt deportert til Irak, og Qatars etterretningssjef sier landet overtok hele forsvarssystemet på seks timer. DNA-testing har identifisert syv familiemedlemmer drept i Syria, og gir håp til de savnede. UCDP registrerte 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
